steps.text: Hey 😊 I'm home and getting ready, and the dress has survived being reconsidered three times
I thought you weren't starting that decision again
I'm not changing it. I'm just looking at it with unnecessary intensity
Completely different
Exactly
The group meeting finished on time, so I even managed a proper lunch
Good. You won't spend the entire date staring at the cake display
That's a separate issue
I wanted to show you before I leave
You look beautiful
I feel good in it
I was about to ask whether you thought it was too much, then I realized I actually liked it
Then keep that answer
I will ❤️
How are you feeling otherwise?
Nervous, but not wishing I'd cancelled
More like the ten minutes before you have to do something and your brain runs out of useful things to say
You don't have to fill all ten minutes with thinking
A radical suggestion
I just sent him a quick photo to say I'm on my way
This one, not the mirror one I sent you
I like that smile
I took two. In the first one I looked like I was trying to remember whether I'd locked the door
Had you?
I was still inside. So no 😭
I sent him a quick photo to say I'm on my way, by the way
Just me at the door, nothing elaborate
You don't have to send it twice
I know. You've already had my full mirror inspection anyway
I'm going now before I find another reason to stand in the hallway
Have a good time. We'll talk when you're free
Thank you for this morning
You don't have to spend the date thinking about what I'd want next
I know. I'm taking that part with me ❤️
I took this before crossing the road. It looks much nicer without the lunch crowd
I'm outside the café. {{name:aiden}} is already here
He looks far too pleased about being the one who arrived first
Don't let him get an entire conversation out of five minutes
Too late, he's pointing at his wrist
I'm putting my phone away before he starts waving at that too
Five whole minutes early. I was about to become concerned
You're not wearing a watch
I know what time it is without one
Then you know I'm early too
I do. I just wanted to enjoy being first
Is this how the entire date is going to be?
I'd like to think I've got a little more to offer
We'll see
You look really nice
Thank you
That's all. You don't have to prepare a comeback to that one
I wasn't
You were a little
You're making me consider one now
Come on. I found two chairs that don't wobble
That's unusually thoughtful of you
Wait until you see the cups. They've done nothing about the cups
Would you mind taking a photo with me before the drinks arrive?
Taking it, or being in it?
Being in it. I can hold the phone
For {{name:player}}?
I'd like one too. But yes, I'd like to send it to him
All right. You can send it to me as well
Then come a little closer or I'm only getting your shoulder
You could have just asked
I did just ask. Look at the phone
We found a table 😊 I asked for a photo before he could complain about the coffee
You both look like you're about to argue over the menu
We already did. This is the peaceful part
Enjoy it. Talk later ❤️
So, how did this morning go?
We actually finished the work. I didn't have to pretend my laptop was about to die to get out
That's disappointing. I wanted to think you'd escaped for me
You get the afternoon. Don't start asking for a dramatic backstory
I still keep thinking about yesterday, you know
The look on your face is going to stay with me for a while
I spent years expecting him to get annoyed when I flirted with you. I did not expect this to be where that went
He has a few things going on that aren't just arguing with you over a game
Apparently. I feel like I've missed an entire chapter
It took me a while too
Did you talk again before coming here?
This morning, yes
And? Am I allowed to ask how that went, or is that private?
Some of it is private. But I asked whether coffee was supposed to be the limit
You asked him that?
Yes
What did he say?
That he doesn't want to set a limit for me. He wants me to decide what I actually feel like doing
Seriously? Just like that?
We talked for longer than that. I'm giving you the useful part
I'm trying to imagine having that conversation and keeping a straight face
You didn't even manage the first sentence yesterday
Fair point
It's still strange to me. Not bad, but strange
It can be strange without us spending the whole date explaining it again
You're right
And it doesn't mean I've arrived with a promise about how today ends
I know. It means I should ask you, not try to guess what he agreed to
Exactly
All right. First question for you, then
Go on
Do you actually want the window seat, or did you take the other one because I was already sitting here?
I wanted the window seat
Then swap with me
Really?
Yes. You're allowed to choose the chair too
You're going to be very annoying about this now, aren't you?
Only until you stop pretending you don't have preferences

steps.title: HAK//NOTICE
messages: Observed gaze lingers lower than intended

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: I knew there was curiosity here, but noticing their attention still catches me off guard.

steps.text: AFTER THEIR COFFEE ARRIVES
Is it good?
Very. You're allowed to enjoy yours even if it's small
It is good. Irritatingly good
That's why you keep coming back
That and it's quiet if you miss the lunch rush
I don't think I've ever been here without watching the time
You usually have somewhere else to be
Classes, work, something I've forgotten to finish
Today I nearly brought my notes in my bag out of habit
You can leave them there
I did. That's what I'm trying to tell you
Sorry. I'm enjoying the fact that you chose to be here
That's a very inconveniently nice answer
I have those occasionally
I know. I just don't always hear them without three jokes afterward
I'm trying not to hide behind those as much today
You don't need to stop being funny
Good, because being handsome and silent sounds exhausting
There he is
What would you do with a whole afternoon free? Not what you should do. What you'd actually do
I'd go for a walk without counting how long I was taking
Maybe find somewhere to sit, listen to something, not answer the class group for a while
There's a garden a couple of streets over
I know the one. I always walk past the entrance
We could go in this time
Yes. I'd like that
LATER, OUTSIDE THE CAFÉ
Left here, isn't it?
Yes. Unless you plan to keep going around the same block
I could pretend I was giving you a tour
Of the place where I go to university?
It needs work
A little
You're being suspiciously quiet
You were worried I'd make a joke
I didn't ask you to stop speaking entirely
I'm having a nice time. I don't want to ruin every quiet bit by filling it
That's new
A little
I like it
A LITTLE LATER, IN THE GARDEN
This is nicer than the path outside
You can hear yourself think in here
I was hoping to do less of that today
How's it going?
Better once we left the café
Was I that bad over coffee?
No. I stopped imagining what I was supposed to do next
And now?
Now I'd like you to stop for a second
Here?
Yes
Okay
You look like you're about to say something dangerous
I was
Then maybe I got impatient

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: A kiss makes this real in a way talking about it never could, and I need a moment with that.

steps.text: Hey
I didn't say you could do that first
You stopped walking and looked at me like that. I took a risk
That wasn't a risk. That was you skipping ahead
So I was right about where this was going
You're really pleased with yourself right now
A little
You were about to kiss me anyway
Keep talking and see what happens
What, you'll stop me again?
Shush
So tell me honestly, who kisses better? Me or him?
{{name:aiden}}
What? It's a valid question
You turn everything into a competition. In games, in class, in life
And now apparently in kissing too
If you really want to know, for now you're still very far behind
Wow. That's cold
You asked
No, I like it. Now it sounds like a challenge
It wasn't supposed to be
Too late. I'm already taking it personally
You're impossible
And yet you kissed me to shut me up
Which should tell you how effective words are with me right now
Want to sit for a little while?
Yes. Over there, in the shade
Look at that. A seating preference without an interrogation
You're one comment away from sitting by yourself
LATER THAT AFTERNOON
Shall I walk you back to the stop?
I'd like that
Do you want to make plans for another day now?
Not right this second. I want a little time to take today in
All right
That isn't a polite way of saying no
I didn't take it as one
Good. I'm glad we did this
So am I
Text me when you're home?
I will
AFTER THEY SAY GOODBYE
I'm on my way home ❤️ That was a good afternoon
I'm glad. How are you feeling?
Happy, and a bit quieter than I expected
I thought I'd want to type everything at once. Mostly I just want to sit with it for a minute
Take your time. You don't have to turn the walk home into a report
I know. I still wanted to send you this
That's a lovely smile
I feel like I've had an actual afternoon off
Not just a gap between two things I needed to do
I'm glad you got that
Can we talk properly when I'm settled at home?
Of course
And tell me something from your day too. I don't want mine to take up all the space
I took this before going in. I like how much light there is in there
I'm at the café by the shopping street. I found a table by the big windows
I'm early, so naturally I'm pretending choosing a drink is a very complicated task
At least you'll have decided by the time he arrives
You would think so
Wait, he's outside. I recognize him from the photos
I'm putting my phone away now. Talk later ❤️
A FEW MINUTES LATER
We ordered, and I asked if he'd be comfortable taking a photo together
He said yes. I told him I'd like to send it to you as well
You look more relaxed already
Actually speaking to someone is easier than trying to imagine the first sentence
Enjoy your coffee. You can tell me how you're doing later
I will 😊
LATER THAT AFTERNOON
A LITTLE LATER
LATER
I'm on my way home 😊 It went well
How are you feeling?
Good. Better than I did when I was studying the drinks menu like there was going to be a test
It was nice not having to carry the whole conversation myself
Was he like you expected?
A bit quieter at first, actually. Which made me feel less silly for being nervous
Then he said he'd promised himself not to spend the first ten minutes explaining the pizza photograph
And did he manage it?
For about four minutes
I asked because I wanted to hear the story, not because he'd run out of things to say
That's a better reason
We ended up walking around afterward. I even came home with a secondhand book I wasn't planning to buy
A productive afternoon
A completely unnecessary purchase, but I like it
Did you enjoy being there, once the nerves settled?
Yes. I stopped trying to decide whether it was going well and just had a nice time
I'm keeping the small details for myself, but I wanted you to know that part
I'm glad you went
So am I ❤️
I took this after we said goodbye
You look happy
I am. And hungry again somehow
I'd like to get home and eat before we talk properly, if that's okay
Of course. I'm not going anywhere
I still want to hear about your day too
It doesn't have to compete with mine to be interesting
I did the washing without starting an international incident with the machine
That's progress
One sock may have been lost in the process
We'll remember its sacrifice
You'd have complained if I hadn't done it
I'm not complaining. I'm deciding how much praise you deserve
At least a little
Then well done, handsome. I'll give you the longer version tonight ❤️
